interface.signature: A: List[int], B: List[int], N: int, M: int -> int

preconditions.description: The size of array A must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The size of array B must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in A)
preconditions.description: All elements in array A must be integers.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in B)
preconditions.description: All elements in array B must be integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1' if any((a, b) for a in A for b in B if sum(A) - a + b == sum(B) - b + a) else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be '1' if there exists a pair (a, b) such that swapping a and b makes the sums of A and B equal, otherwise '0'.
